summary: This pass verifies the author-adopted formula and its connected UI. Earlier test counts covered a superseded capped model and must not be used as evidence for this rule.
Exact concept policy does not mean official OpenAI pricing or proven commercial economics. Original Pasta Board remains unchanged.
method: 28 Node tests plus direct cloud-Chrome interaction. Browser checks are observed procedures, not an unattended end-to-end suite.
Desktop review and 320/375/390 CSS-pixel content widths used narrow iframe viewports. These are responsive layout checks, not physical iPhone, touch, Safari or screen-reader certification.
The earlier report and tests remain under review/interaction-repair and review/adopted-formula/superseded-tests in the source archive.
changes: One adopted settlement function replaces the default200 ceiling and independent continuous curve.
Expandable formula/table drawer with selected examples, cent-level variations, boundary cases, linked receipt and v2 share URLs.
Uber origin note beside billing, linked from the companion; semicolon declarations preserved.
Shared field readiness guard prevents input before hydration; explicit tier adjustments show either direction.
Markdown, JSON, static formula page, research index and download updated together.
